item.title: Suspect killed after opening fire on Secret Service near White House
item.description: Officials say a suspect approached a checkpoint near the building and opened fire, and that a bystander was wounded.

item.title: Turkish police storm opposition offices after leaders ousted
item.description: Officers stormed the building days after the party vowed to defy a court ruling removing its leaders.

item.title: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
item.description: The Oreshnik missile, which reportedly travels over 10 times the speed of sound, was used, Russia has confirmed.

item.title: More than 500 children have died in an outbreak that the world is virtually ignoring
item.description: The number of cases — and deaths — in Bangladesh is staggering. As of Sunday, 528 have died, mostly children. How did this measles outbreak begin? And how is the country responding?

item.title: Mind-bending photos by anonymous cousins show the pain and dreams of Afghan women
item.description: The young women make photos that look at life — how it is, how they wish it could be — under Taliban rule. The images are on display at the Photoville Festival in Brooklyn, New York.

item.title: Why did I put myself through the pain of going to court, rape victim tells BBC
item.description: A girl who was raped by two teenage boys has told the BBC that a judge's decision to spare them jail sentences was like a "rock straight in my face".

item.title: Girl raped by boys spared jail tells BBC judge's decision was like 'rock in my face'
item.description: Speaking to the BBC’s Laura Kuenssberg, the girl, who is now 16, said: "What was the point in putting me through that?"

item.title: Religious leaders, lawmakers push for $1 billion to secure houses of worship
item.description: There's an effort on Capitol Hill to increase funding for the Nonprofit Security Grant Program, which awards funding to houses of worship to harden their defenses. In 2024, roughly a third of those who applied actually received funding.

item.title: BBC at the site of China's worst mining disaster in more than a decade
item.description: At least 82 people have been killed after a gas explosion at the Liushenyu mine in China.
